subject: 🧪 OpenAI MedChemBench: GPT-6 Astra fails drug selection at 50%
notes: No rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or price changes in this issue. Sponsor blocks (Fireworks.ai, MongoDB, Tiger Data) and event promos ignored.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases MedChemBench, a benchmark of how well models find drug candidates
stories.quote: OpenAI releases benchmark measuring how well models find new drug candidates

facts.text: The issue says the benchmark and the safety paper came out on the same Thursday.
facts.quote: OpenAI had a big Thursday. A drug discovery benchmark and a safety paper dropped the same day. Two very different problems, one common thread:

facts.text: Benchmark draws on 117 papers and patents, 761 molecular structures, 99 problems.
facts.quote: It pulls from 117 papers and patents, with 761 molecular structures across 99 problems.

facts.text: GPT-6 Astra scored 95.4% on structure tasks and about half on compound selection and numerical prediction.
facts.quote: scored 95.4% on structure tasks, but only about half on compound selection and numerical prediction.

stories.headline: OpenAI publishes research on adversarial distillation bypassing safety guardrails, and its defences
stories.quote: OpenAI reveals how model distillation bypasses safety guardrails and how to stop it

facts.text: Attack success rate fell from 54% on GPT-6 Astra to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra (figures split across lines in the issue).
Weekly enforcement actions cover thousands to tens of thousands of accounts running distillation campaigns.
facts.quote: Weekly enforcement actions have hit thousands to tens of thousands of accounts running distillation campaigns.

facts.text: Older model families are blocked from reading GPT-6.2's protected reasoning.
facts.quote: Older model families with weaker safeguards are now blocked from reading GPT-6.2's protected reasoning.

stories.headline: Google Antigravity upgrades /btw to fork a parallel agent conversation mid-task
stories.quote: Google Antigravity upgrades its CLI tool to let you fork and explore agent threads mid-task

stories.headline: Thinking Machines releases a 26B open-source model that runs on 16GB RAM
stories.quote: Thinking Machines drops 26B open-source model that runs on 16GB RAM

stories.headline: NVIDIA publishes CPU-ARC, a method caching LLM reasoning as CPU code at up to 291x lower cost
stories.quote: NVIDIA method caches LLM reasoning as CPU code, cutting costs up to 291x

facts.quote: Meanwhile NVIDIA quietly published CPU-ARC, caching LLM reasoning as plain CPU code at up to 291x lower cost. Capability, safety, efficiency. One news cycle.
